name: Fontshare
description: Free, professional-grade typeface library created by the Indian Type Foundry.
highlight: Features high-end fonts like Satoshi, Cabinet Grotesk, Clash Display, and General Sans.

name: Google Fonts
description: Over 1,500 open-source font families accessible via direct download or CDN.
highlight: Industry standard including Inter, Roboto, Outfit, and Playfair Display.

name: Velvetyne Type Foundry
description: Open-source typography collective releasing experimental and distinctive libre fonts.
highlight: Distinctive editorial and display typefaces for bold branding.

name: Lucide Icons
description: Over 1,400 sharp, consistent vector icons. The community-maintained successor to Feather.
highlight: Full support for React, Vue, Svelte, SVG, and Figma.

name: Tabler Icons
description: 5,200+ customizable stroke-based vector icons for modern web apps.
highlight: Configurable stroke width, color, and size directly in browser.

name: Remix Icon
description: Neutral, elegant icon set with 2,800+ symbols in both outline and filled styles.
highlight: Great coverage of media, document, and office UI symbols.

name: Unsplash
description: Over 5 million high-resolution photography assets from a global creator community.
highlight: Ideal for website hero headers, blog thumbnails, and background imagery.

name: Pexels
description: High-quality royalty-free photos and 4K stock video footage.
highlight: Includes vertical video footage tailored for TikTok and Instagram Reels.

name: Public Domain Archive (Library of Congress & NASA)
description: Historical prints, space photography, and vintage posters in the public domain.
highlight: 100% immune from copyright claims and takedown notices.

name: Freesound
description: Collaborative database of over 500,000 creative-commons licensed audio samples and field recordings.
attribution: Depends on sample (CC0: None, CC-BY: Required)
highlight: Filter by CC0 license to find 100,000+ attribution-free sounds.

name: Sonniss GDC Audio Archives
description: Over 150 GB of commercial-grade sound effects released every year during GDC.
highlight: Foley, impacts, cinematic hits, monster roars, and ambient environments.

name: Incompetech (Kevin MacLeod)
description: Over 2,000 recognizable, versatile background music tracks across every genre.
highlight: The soundtrack behind thousands of top YouTube videos and indie games.

name: ambientCG
description: Over 2,000 public-domain PBR material textures, 3D scans, and HDRIs.
highlight: Up to 8K resolution diffuse, normal, roughness, and displacement maps.

name: Poly Pizza
description: Searchable archive of thousands of low-poly 3D models from Google Poly creators.
highlight: Download .obj and .gltf assets ready for Blender, Godot, or Three.js.

name: Kenney.nl (Asset Jesus)
description: Thousands of 2D sprites, 3D modular assets, sound effects, and UI components.
highlight: The gold standard for game prototyping, game jams, and indie releases.
